game.title: Ninja Gaiden 2 Black

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's description calls this a remaster of Ninja Gaiden 2; it uses its own Steam app, 3287520 ("NINJA GAIDEN 2 Black"), not the older NINJA GAIDEN Σ2. No StrategyWiki page under "Ninja Gaiden 2 Black" or "Ninja Gaiden II Black". ninjagaiden.fandom.com has no page under either title, so Fandom is unverified. 17 of 38 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter. Their names read like story chapters ("Sky City Tokyo", "The Lycanthropes' Castle", "The Temple of Sacrifice") and, at very low unlock rates, like difficulty or rank goals ("Trial of the Acolyte", "Mark of the Master Ninja") and other playable characters ("Kunoichi", "Fiend Hunter"), but the data does not say so, so they were not split. RAWG lists PC and PlayStation 5 as platforms.
